mapper.select: SELECT * FROM textbook_class_binding WHERE semester = #{semester} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY college, major, class_name, book_name
SELECT * FROM textbook_class_binding WHERE semester = #{semester} AND class_name = #{className} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY book_name
SELECT college, major, class_name AS className FROM textbook_class_binding WHERE semester = #{semester} AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY college, major, class_name ORDER BY college, major, class_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_class_binding (semester, college, major, class_name, book_id, isbn, book_name, planned_qty, source, pending_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{semester}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{bookId}, #{isbn}, #{bookName}, #{plannedQty}, #{source}, #{pendingId}, #{createBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE planned_qty = planned_qty + VALUES(planned_qty), pending_id = VALUES(pending_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE textbook_class_binding SET planned_qty = #{plannedQty} WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId}
UPDATE textbook_class_binding SET del_flag = '2' WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId}
UPDATE textbook_class_binding SET del_flag = '2' WHERE pending_id = #{pendingId} AND source = '1'
